title: Counties with greater modeled wildfire exposure show somewhat higher voluntary-market nonrenewal in a 2022 California screen
source_unit: California Department of Insurance county exposure appendix joined to aggregated voluntary-market ZIP policy counts

lowest_exposure_quartile_nonrenewal_rate.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions

highest_exposure_quartile_nonrenewal_rat.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions

below_12_1_percent_exposure_nonrenewal_r.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions

at_or_above_12_1_percent_exposure_nonren.unit: percent among voluntary renewed plus nonrenewed decisions

observations.method: Aggregated 2022 ZIP-level new, renewed, and nonrenewed counts by county; joined county rows to CDI's modeled high/very-high dwelling-unit share; compared equal-count exposure quartiles and the published 12.1% California threshold.
observations.uncertainty: The exposure appendix uses Department of Finance dwelling-unit estimates as of January 1, 2015; voluntary decisions are from 2022. Exposure is a modelers' weighted average, not observed loss or household risk.
observations.subgroup: Matched counties with nonblank county names in the voluntary workbook.
observations.counterinterpretation: The difference may reflect county composition, insurer mix, property type, reporting practices, or other market conditions; it does not show wildfire exposure caused nonrenewal or that FAIR enrollment caused a transition.

related_sources.claim: CDI publishes county dwelling-unit estimates and weighted high/very-high wildfire exposure shares.
related_sources.access_boundary: The appendix is a modeled exposure context with a 2015 dwelling-unit base.

related_sources.claim: CDI publishes statewide 2018–2023 insurer coverage and loss measures segmented by risk score.
related_sources.access_boundary: The workbook has no county or household key and is not merged into the county result.

related_sources.claim: Local analysis output records the county join and comparisons.
related_sources.access_boundary: The join is descriptive and temporally mismatched.

boundary: This record conditions the California voluntary-market nonrenewal screen on CDI modeled county wildfire exposure. It does not establish causality, household coverage loss, affordability, repairs, moves, or political response.
